title: Adopt @tiptap/static-renderer: DOM-free JSON→HTML in styled-text-server + sync-server
description:
Adopt `@tiptap/static-renderer` in styled-text-server (and sync-server) to render PM JSON -> HTML string with NO DOM — removes the JSDOM dependency and becomes the foundation for the Slack/plain-text/markdown projections.

**Integration details (researched 2026-08-12):**
- Package: `@tiptap/static-renderer` ^3.29.2, MIT. Entry: `import { renderToHTMLString } from '@tiptap/static-renderer/pm/html-string'` — takes `{extensions, content}` where extensions = our kits from @campsite/editor; no jsdom, no editor instance. Also has React and markdown targets under other subpaths, and per-node `nodeMapping`/`markMapping` overrides for custom output.
- styled-text-server: apps/styled-text-server/src/markdown.ts currently does markdown -> parsedNode -> DOMSerializer.fromSchema(...).serializeFragment with a JSDOM document. Replace the serialize half with renderToHTMLString(node.toJSON()). JSDOM still needed by the PARSE half (our MarkdownParser uses DOMParser for html blocks) — full JSDOM removal only lands with the parse migration; this bead still deletes the DOMSerializer/JSDOM usage on output and unblocks the other projections.
- sync-server: apps/sync-server/src/database.ts store() uses generateHTML from @tiptap/html — same swap applies; fetch() uses generateJSON (parse direction, keep).
- Suggested structure: export a shared `renderDocumentToHTML(json, editorKind)` from packages/editor so web/sync-server/styled-text-server use ONE renderer.
- moduleResolution note: repo tsconfigs use "node"; subpath imports like `@tiptap/static-renderer/pm/html-string` may need the dist-path workaround used for `@tiptap/react/dist/menus` (see EditorBubbleMenu.tsx) — or works directly in styled-text-server if its tsconfig uses node16/bundler (check apps/styled-text-server/tsconfig.json, it was modernized recently).

title: styled-text-server: rebuild html_to_slack as ProseMirror serialization
description:
Rebuild html_to_slack as a ProseMirror serialization instead of cheerio string surgery: parse HTML into a PM doc with our schema, then map nodes -> Slack blocks explicitly.

**Current code:** apps/styled-text-server/src/html.ts (~179 lines): cheerio + jsx-slack with string-level hacks (br/hr self-closing rewrites, checkbox -> emoji, blockquote heading flattening, 2000-char link stripping, hr -> unicode line). Unknown HTML silently leaks or is stripped.

**Integration details (researched 2026-08-12):**
- Parse: PM DOMParser.fromSchema(schema) over the incoming HTML (schema from @campsite/editor kits) — this alone structurally sanitizes input (only schema-known nodes/marks survive).
- Serialize: walk the doc (or use @tiptap/static-renderer's nodeMapping with a custom target) emitting jsx-slack elements/Block Kit JSON per node type: paragraph->Section, heading->bold Section/Header, bulletList/orderedList/taskItem (checkbox emoji logic moves into the taskItem handler), codeBlock->code fence, blockquote->quote prefix, hr->divider, link (keep the >2000 char guard, now per-mark), mention->@display, image/attachment->context or link.
- Unknown node types: throw/log loudly instead of leaking markup.
- Consumers in api: post/build_slack_blocks.rb, comment/build_slack_blocks.rb, zapier paths — API contract unchanged (same /html_to_slack in+out), so ship behind a comparison test: run old cheerio path vs new path over fixture corpus (existing __tests__ in apps/styled-text-server) and diff.

title: Refactor editor consumers for deferred SSR mounting
description: The current note, Markdown, and chat editor consumers dereference the result of useEditor synchronously. Tiptap v3's immediatelyRender: false makes that result nullable until client initialization, so adopt guarded rendering and then enable deferred SSR-safe initialization before considering manual mount/unmount reuse.
design: Keep each editor's content and collaboration provider ownership local. Do not reuse one instance across notes/posts; validate hydration, focus, attachments, comments, and collaboration lifecycle before changing editor mount behavior.
acceptance_criteria: All editor consumers safely handle a null initial editor; immediatelyRender: false is enabled where SSR applies; hydration and focused editor interactions pass; no stale content or collaboration providers survive a remount.

title: Evaluate FileHandler extension vs custom paste/drop upload plumbing
description:
Evaluate replacing the custom paste/drop upload plumbing with `@tiptap/extension-file-handler` (free/MIT since Tiptap 3).

**Current code:** apps/web/components/MarkdownEditor/useEditorFileHandlers.ts (~114 lines) implements editorProps handlePaste/handleDrop wired into useUploadAttachments; notes use apps/web/components/Post/Notes/Attachments/useUploadAttachments.ts.

**Integration details (researched 2026-08-12):**
- Package: `@tiptap/extension-file-handler` ^3.29.2. Config: `onDrop(editor, files, pos)`, `onPaste(editor, files, htmlContent)`, `allowedMimeTypes`.
- Would replace the editorProps handlers with extension config, keeping our upload pipeline (optimistic attachment nodes via insertAttachments command in packages/editor PostNoteAttachment).
- Gotcha: onPaste gives you `htmlContent` when the clipboard has both HTML and files — our current handler has ordering logic for that case (e.g. pasting an image copied from a browser); port it carefully.
- Low urgency: current code is thin and battle-tested. Do it opportunistically when next touching upload UX.

title: Product call: Mathematics (LaTeX) support in notes
description:
PRODUCT CALL: math/LaTeX rendering in notes via `@tiptap/extension-mathematics` (free/MIT since Tiptap 3).

**Integration details (researched 2026-08-12):**
- Packages: `@tiptap/extension-mathematics` ^3.29.2 + peer `katex` (+ katex CSS import in apps/web).
- Inline `$...$` and block `$$...$$` input rules; stores LaTeX source in node attrs.
- Follow-on work if adopted (this is the real cost, not the extension itself):
  - markdownParseSpec/markdownToken integration in packages/editor so styled-text-server markdown_to_html round-trips math (markdown-it needs a texmath plugin, e.g. markdown-it-texmath).
  - Slack conversion fallback in apps/styled-text-server/src/html.ts (render as `code` span with the raw TeX).
  - NOTE_SCHEMA_VERSION bump (new node types in persisted docs) — same deploy dance as UniqueID bead.
- Skip unless users actually ask for math.
